entities.name: Fiachnae mac Báetáin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fíachnae mac Báetáin, also called Fíachnae Lurgan or Fíachnae Find, was king of the Dál nAraidi and High King of the Ulaid in the early 7th century. He was a son of Báetán mac Echdach and brother of Fiachra Cáech, grandson of the Ulaid king Eochaid mac Condlai and father of Mongán mac Fiachnai.
